sentences: The input is a triangulated three-manifold, and the question is whether it is a closed hyperbolic manifold.
The target is an NP certificate: compact evidence that a deterministic verifier can check in polynomial time.
The cited report suggests that finding a suitably short systolic curve might contribute to such a certificate.
A terminating recognition algorithm does not itself establish the required certificate-size bound.
The problem connects a global geometric classification with the amount of finite combinatorial evidence needed to verify that classification.
